pr_body:
Unit tests now build and most pass. The tests that do not pass require certain tables to be implemented.

Closes #2423

issue_context.title: Windows: build and run core and additional tests
issue_context.body:
1. The windows build should produce a `osquery_tests` and `osquery_addtional_tests`.
2. The CI should run a `.bat` script to kick off executions of these tests.

I am assigning this to the Windows Remove milestone because we cannot close that until we verify the TLS plugins work.

review_comments:
If we need to do platform-specific stuff and there are no platform-API specific calls then use the `isPlatform(TYPE_WINDOWS)` or otherwise. This allows easier static analysis and code coverage.
This is blocked off using `#ifdef WIN32` gates because using `std::gmtime` on Windows triggers a insecure API warning. So, for this case, I don't think `isPlatform(TYPE_WINDOWS)` will work.
